discussion_comments.comment_body:
**#8 Nit (PLAUSIBLE): the removed guard specifically protected APP_DIR=/app.**

The old `{ [ "$APP_DIR" = "/app" ] || [ "${APP_DIR#/app/}" != "$APP_DIR" ] || chown ...; }` skipped the chown when APP_DIR was `/app` or under it. The new unconditional `chown -R appuser:0 "$APP_DIR" && chmod -R g=rwX "$APP_DIR"` means a build with `--build-arg ARG_APP_DIR=/app` makes `/app/main` and the entrypoint group-0-writable, which an OpenShift arbitrary-UID (GID 0) process could overwrite, and which image scanners flag. `ARG_APP_DIR` is undocumented as an override knob, so this is theoretical with the default `/app/data`, but a one-line guard (or a build-time assertion that `$APP_DIR` is not `/app`) preserves the old protection. Same applies to `Dockerfile.local`.
